description: Cross-Platform Arbitrage & Resolution Rules Lawyer — Finds fine-print divergences between two prediction markets (e.g. Polymarket vs Kalshi), prices basis risk after fees, and returns verdict.action ARBITRAGE_SAFE / LOW_ANNUALIZED_YIELD / BASIS_RISK_TRAP / NO_EDGE / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with edge in bps, the probability both legs lose, days to resolution, annualized return and Kelly hedge size capped by top-of-book depth. bankrollUsd.description: Used to convert the Kelly fraction to USD.

endDate.description: ISO date this market resolves; sets days to resolution and the annualized return.

feeBps.description: Trading fee on this leg in bps of notional.

market.description: Polymarket slug, market URL or conditionId, or a Kalshi ticker or URL. Fills platform, title, resolution rules, best-ask prices, per-leg fees and end date from the live market; any field you also pass overrides it. Without market, platform, title, resolutionRules, yesPrice and noPrice are required.

noPrice.description: Best ask for one No share in USD (0-1).

resolutionRules.description: Exact resolution rules and fine print.

yesFeeBps.description: Fee in bps of notional for buying Yes here; overrides feeBps for that leg.
